# QMD Linking and Backlink Rules

## Rule
Every important QMD page should:
- link outward to related pages
- be linked back from at least one hub/index page
- use stable relative links
- repeat canonical object names in body/frontmatter

## Recommended sections
- Summary
- Purpose
- Current truth
- Gaps / tensions
- Related
- Backlinks expected from

## Backlink sources
- artifact index
- object registry
- track pages
- implementation pages
- imports/comparison pages
- decision pages
